name: coreflux
description: Author, deploy, and operate Coreflux MQTT brokers from Cursor. LoT (Language of Things) authoring skills, every broker command over MQTT ($SYS/Coreflux/Command), live topic publish/subscribe, notebook deployment, docs search, and safety hooks for destructive operations.

COREFLUX_BROKERS.title: Broker profiles
COREFLUX_BROKERS.description: Optional list of named brokers the agent can switch between with broker_use, e.g. "local=mqtt://root:pass@localhost:1883; edge=mqtts://ops:pass@10.0.0.5:8883?tlsInsecure=true; prod=mqtts://mqtt.example.com:8883?passwordEnv=PROD_MQTT_PASSWORD". Users can add more in ~/.coreflux/brokers.json or <workspace>/.coreflux/brokers.json.

COREFLUX_BROKER.title: Active broker profile
COREFLUX_BROKER.description: Name of the profile to use by default (from Broker profiles or a brokers.json file). Leave empty to use the connection fields below, the workspace's saved choice, or mqtt://localhost:1883.

COREFLUX_MQTT_URL.title: Broker URL
COREFLUX_MQTT_URL.description: Single-broker setup: MQTT URL of the Coreflux broker, e.g. mqtt://localhost:1883 or mqtts://broker.example.com:8883. Becomes the profile named "default".

COREFLUX_MQTT_USERNAME.title: Broker username
COREFLUX_MQTT_USERNAME.description: MQTT username used for broker commands. Needs CommandCall permission (root, admin, or AllowedSystemConfiguration).

COREFLUX_MQTT_PASSWORD.title: Broker password
COREFLUX_MQTT_PASSWORD.description: MQTT password for the user above.

COREFLUX_MQTT_CLIENT_ID.title: Client id
COREFLUX_MQTT_CLIENT_ID.description: Optional fixed MQTT client id. A random cursor-coreflux-* id is used when empty.

COREFLUX_MQTT_TLS_INSECURE.title: Skip TLS verification
COREFLUX_MQTT_TLS_INSECURE.description: Set to "true" to accept self-signed broker certificates on mqtts:// connections (development only).
